title: The uncertainty spectrum
body: Wildfires in Australia, mass protests in the US, a global pandemic. These are just some of the events that have roiled markets this year, leaving investors feeling more uneasy than they have felt in a long time. The future seems abnormally uncertain at the moment, but it is important to remember that the future is always uncertain. Watch this 4-min clip, from our offshore partner Orbis, to learn more about how we manage uncertainty.
